title: viola heterophylla subsp. cavillieri
intro: Viola heterophylla subsp. cavillieri, commonly known as Yellow Pansy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family (Violaceae). The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Viola heterophylla subsp. cavillieri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. These properties make the plant a potential candidate for the treatment of various health conditions, including gastrointestinal disorders, respiratory infections, and skin conditions.
